# BlitzBasic: Runtime

Timers, delays, program information and the environment.

Time, the program itself and the system it runs on. The timers [CreateTimer](CreateTimer), [WaitTimer](WaitTimer) and [FreeTimer](FreeTimer) are the simple way to run a loop at a fixed speed.
